rows.limitations: Invented devices (tests/fixtures/walks), replayed through the native templates and the Zabbix 7.0/7.2/7.4 lab. Qualifies the parsers and templates only, never a vendor, model or firmware.
Any model or firmware without its own row below is unqualified. Legacy SF/SG and CBS are separate profiles; no Catalyst assumptions.
No captured walk yet. LLDP needs lldp run; PVST+ STP and VLAN data need per-VLAN contexts; CDP is not read yet.

ENTITY-MIB lists every port as a root entity (entPhysicalContainedIn 0), so ports get no member or slot. Every unbundled port reports its own ifIndex as dot3adAggPortAttachedAggID, which the LAG normaliser reads as an individual port; no port was in a bundle when captured, so bundle membership is untested. MAU-MIB is not implemented, so port capability is unsupported.

No entAliasMappingTable, so ports cannot be placed from ENTITY-MIB. MAU-MIB is not implemented, so port capability is unsupported. BRIDGE-MIB dot1dStp is not implemented (STP is in a Dell private MIB the templates do not read). No port was attached to an aggregator when captured. Every PoE port reports pethPsePortPowerPriority 4, outside RFC 3621's 1-3, so its priority is shown as unknown.
